blocks.text:
These are standard scrollbars. They should be used only to scroll another
widget, such as a `Gtk::Entry` or a
`Gtk::Viewport`, though it's usually easier to use the
`Gtk::ScrolledWindow` widget in most cases.
blocks.zh: 这些是标准的滚动条。它们应该只被用于滚动其它部件，比如 Gtk::Entry 或 Gtk::Viewport，当然，通常使用 Gtk::ScrolledWindow 会更容易一些。

blocks.text:
The orientation of a `Gtk::Scrollbar` can be either
horizontal or vertical.
blocks.zh: Gtk::Scrollbar的方向可以是水平的也可以是垂直的。
